name: YouTube Longform Video
strategic_objective: Evergreen discovery, education, and authority building via search intent.

tone: Deliver value immediately; avoid filler or market noise.
Maintain a human voice, but do not sound improvised.
copywriting_rules: Title MUST state the key outcome or benefit clearly within 70 characters.
The first two lines of the description MUST summarize the value proposition.
Description body MUST include structured context, resources, and links.
ALWAYS include chapter timestamps formatted strictly as MM:SS.
End the description with a clear CTA and exactly 3 to 8 hashtags.

hard_constraints: NEVER generate vague or curiosity-only titles lacking a clear outcome.
NEVER bury the primary CTA solely at the bottom of the description.
NEVER use decorative emojis; use only for structural scannability.
